summary: The authors’ DESeq2 worksheet for adult GnRH-depleted POA matched 15,677 genes, covering 99.77% of the registered output. Direction agreed for 14,878 of 15,674 nonzero pairs (94.92%), meeting author-concordance-v2 through its direction criterion. Pearson was 0.8543 and Spearman was 0.9637. Both analyses reported zero discoveries at FDR < 0.05. The proposal passed validation.
openIssues: The registered track measures GnRH-depleted supernatant. Its five controls include four vehicle-treated pools and one pool from an untreated dam, Sample_95732.
Effect magnitudes and nominal P values differ. Five paired genes lack author P and FDR values. Full verification remains open.
Two ancillary gene-ontology workbooks were identifiable from the authors’ README but unavailable for download. The complete gene-level treatment worksheet was recovered.
